title: GT-599 — rows grandfathered out of the principal/interest requirement
why: GT-599's second acceptance criterion is that the tracking guard REJECTS A NEW OPEN ROW without a
principal and an interest. That has to be enforceable the day it lands, and on this board it is not:
47 rows were already open with no economics, and back-filling them with invented figures would
fabricate exactly the unsourced number the field exists to eliminate.
So the requirement is armed forward-only. Every id listed here is an OPEN row as of recordedOn and is
exempt; every open row that is NOT listed here — which is to say every row opened after this file was
written — must carry the fields or the guard fails.
This list only ever shrinks. Adding an id to it is granting a new row the exemption the whole gap
exists to remove, and new-row-economics-guard.test.mjs pins the size so that edit cannot pass
unnoticed. Filling a listed row's economics is the way off this list; deleting the entry afterwards is
optional (a listed row that HAS economics is simply no longer interesting to the guard).
